framework: Next.js 16.4.2 app router, Tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/turbopack, cacheComponents on
fonts: Space Grotesk (display) + Geist (body) + Geist Mono (readouts, code) via next/font in app/layout.tsx
palette: Hallmark Cobalt tokens in tokens.css (OKLCH, light + dark), mapped to Tailwind utilities in app/globals.css; shadcn-style aliases kept for streamdown
motion: none (motion-cut); button press, loading pulse, delayed loading-text fade
spacing: named 4-pt scale (--space-3xs … --space-2xl) mapped to Tailwind spacing utilities
